info.name: SLNG Voice Agents Account Speechmatics API
info.description:
Public API for managing Voice Agents, dispatching outbound calls, and creating web (non-telephony) sessions.

Base URL: `https://api.agents.slng.ai`


Contact Support:
 Name: SLNG Support
 Email: support@slng.ai

request.description: Submit audio for asynchronous transcription. Supports file upload (`multipart/form-data`), URL input, and presigned S3 upload (`application/json`). For the presigned-upload flow, the first call (`mode: "presign"`) returns **200 OK** with an upload URL — the job is not created until step 3. All other submission paths return **202 Accepted** with `status: QUEUED`.

response.name: **Presign mode only.** Returns a presigned upload URL; the job is not created yet. See the [Batch guide](/batch-guide#method-3-presigned-upload) for the full upload flow.
